runs.request: Build a premium landing page for an AI developer tool. The experience should feel cinematic, immersive and highly polished. I want meaningful 3D, smooth motion, strong typography, depth and interesting interactions. Do not make it look like a generic AI SaaS template. Use advanced frontend techniques only where they improve the experience.

decisions.why: 3D explicitly requested; one bounded hero scene
entrance → interaction → exit; one easing family
